title: Exact snapshots; measured 10% glass overhead reduction
changes: Jolt update, contact observation, preparation and trial snapshot/restore timings now appear in Physics & record. Timers never control physics.
Reusable bounded storage retains every native state byte and preserves nested rollback; contact observations no longer copy a fresh stream.
Balanced glass comparison: 35.57 s versus 39.56 s for two physical seconds, about 10% less request wall time. Physical/work fields match exactly.
Nine scoped CTests and complete glass/oak/iron/ice reference comparisons pass. Full coupled-friction comparisons are running and are not claimed as completed here. All five broader goals remain open.
